title: Generator
description: A pitch collection made by stacking a generator within a period.

title.label: Title
title.heading: Generator
title.body: A generated collection is made by repeatedly applying one interval, called a generator, and folding the results into a period. This is a compact way to build scales with strong internal structure.

prerequisites.label: Period
prerequisites.body: The period is the frame that the generator folds into.

lab.label: Lab
lab.prompt: The Generator lab will go here.

qa.label: Q&A
qa.question: How is a generated collection built?

choices.text: By stacking a generator and reducing each result into a period.
By using only one pitch class.

items.title: Choose a generator
items.body: Pick an interval and describe what happens when it is stacked several times.

items.title: Fold into a period
items.body: Explain why reducing generated notes into the period makes a scale easier to compare.
